name: sso
description: AWS IAM Identity Center (successor to AWS Single Sign-On) Portal is a web service that makes it easy for you to assign user access to IAM Identity Center resources such as the AWS access portal.

subcommands.name: get-role-credentials
subcommands.description: Returns the STS short-term credentials for a given role name that is assigned to the user.

subcommands.name: list-account-roles
subcommands.description: Lists all roles that are assigned to the user for a given AWS account.

subcommands.name: list-accounts
subcommands.description: Lists all AWS accounts assigned to the user.

subcommands.name: logout
subcommands.description: Removes the locally stored SSO tokens from the client-side cache and sends an API call to the IAM Identity Center service to invalidate the corresponding server-side IAM Identity Center sign in session.
